Man Abducted and Beaten Over Unpaid Phone EMI

A young man was allegedly abducted and beaten for failing to pay his mobile phone's equated monthly installment (EMI). Two individuals have been taken into custody in connection with the incident. Authorities are searching for the main accused. The incident highlights a violent method of debt recovery for mobile phone payments.
